problem: Sub-contractor insolvency (StålBygg AS) — 9-week programme impact and remobilisation costs NOK 95M
handling_plan: StålBygg AS declared insolvency on 12.12.2025 with immediate effect. NordicSteel JV was engaged as replacement on 18.01.2026 following an emergency tender. Remobilisation costs estimated at NOK 95M including equipment, site setup and acceleration measures. Productivity currently 30% below plan. Formal recovery programme submitted to Board 01.02.2026.

problem: Cost overrun tracking at NOK 123M above baseline — contingency draw requested
handling_plan: EAC revision completed 30.01.2026. Overrun driven by sub-contractor insolvency (NOK 95M) and approved fire suppression scope change (NOK 28M). Total EAC now 2.61 BNOK. Contingency reserve of NOK 60M formally requested by PM. Remaining exposure of NOK 63M requires Board approval for additional funding. Sensitivity analysis shows further risk of NOK 20–40M if recovery programme underperforms.

problem: Grid connection with Elvia stalled — revised load profile submission required
handling_plan: Elvia paused all connection works on 07.01.2026 following receipt of a revised load profile from the client that increased Phase 2 demand from 40 MW to 55 MW. A new capacity assessment is mandatory before network reinforcement works can resume. Timeline: 8–12 weeks for assessment. Risk of Phase 1 commissioning delay if assessment exceeds 10 weeks.

problem: Client issued formal notice of schedule concern — relationship risk
handling_plan: Customer (NordCloud AS) issued a formal notice of concern on 29.01.2026 citing 9-week programme slip and requesting a recovery plan with milestones no later than 14.02.2026. Legal review ongoing regarding liquidated damages clause (LD rate: NOK 500K/day after contractual completion). Engagement meeting with customer's technical director scheduled 10.02.2026.

problem: Steel fabrication delay at StructoFab AB — impact on structural erection programme
handling_plan:
StructoFab AB notified NordFjord Bygg JV on 19.01.2026 of a 4-week reduction in fabrication capacity following an internal restructuring that resulted in the loss of two key welding teams. A resequencing plan has been developed in collaboration with the site team, absorbing 2 weeks of the delay through overlapping erection and connection works. Net programme impact assessed at 2 weeks on the structural completion milestone.

Update 03.02.2026: Resequencing plan approved by Bulk. StructoFab has confirmed first steel delivery from revised schedule on 12.03.2026. Monitoring weekly.

problem: PFAS soil contamination identified on northern plot — NOK 38M scope addition
handling_plan:
Environmental sampling completed by Multiconsult on 09.01.2026 confirmed elevated PFAS concentrations in soil on the northern 1.4 ha of the site, likely legacy contamination from previous industrial use. Remediation scope assessed at NOK 38M (excavation, off-site disposal and validation sampling). A formal change order has been submitted to the land vendor citing warranty provisions in the purchase agreement. Legal review ongoing.

Update 03.02.2026: Change order submitted 28.01.2026. Land vendor has engaged their own technical advisor. Parallel track: remediation tender issued to three contractors to avoid programme delay while legal process runs.

problem: HV connection agreement with Lnett not yet signed — 30 MW capacity at risk
handling_plan:
Lnett (grid operator) has indicated that the regulatory approval process for the 30 MW HV connection upgrade is taking longer than planned due to NVE permit backlog. Current projection pushes the HV energisation date 6–10 weeks beyond the original programme. Phase 1 commissioning at 12 MW (using existing local grid headroom) is not affected. Phase 2 full capacity is at risk.

Update 03.02.2026: Escalation meeting with Lnett held 01.02.2026. NVE permit submission confirmed received and under review. Exploring temporary diesel bridging (cost estimate NOK 4–7M) as mitigation for Phase 2 gap.

problem: Lead MEP design engineer on extended sick leave — knowledge transfer risk
handling_plan:
The lead MEP design engineer from IngeniørTeam AS was placed on extended sick leave from 05.01.2026. A deputy engineer (Halvard Tveit) has been assigned, but onboarding and knowledge transfer have taken longer than anticipated due to insufficient design documentation handover procedures. Risk of MEP design delays affecting procurement lead times for HVAC and UPS equipment.

Mitigation: additional review sessions scheduled between deputy and Bulk's internal MEP specialist. Design freeze deadline for MEP extended by 2 weeks to 28.02.2026.

problem: Main contractor programme baseline not yet formally accepted
handling_plan:
The NordFjord Bygg JV submitted their Level 3 programme on 16.01.2026. Bulk's programme review identified 4 activities with insufficient float buffers ahead of critical path milestones. NordFjord Bygg has been requested to revise and resubmit. Until the baseline is formally accepted, progress reporting and change impact assessments cannot be benchmarked reliably.

Update 03.02.2026: Revised programme submitted 31.01.2026. Bulk review in progress — acceptance expected by 14.02.2026.

problem: NCR — compaction layer thickness in eastern access road sub-base
handling_plan: Site QC inspection on 22.01.2026 identified that the sub-base compaction layer thickness in the eastern access road deviated from specification (measured 220mm vs. required 300mm) over approximately 180 linear metres. NCR raised (NOV-NCR-0003). Contractor submitted corrective action plan — full removal and re-compaction to required depth. Works corrected and re-inspected 29.01.2026. NCR closed with no programme impact.

problem: Cold-weather curing delay on structural concrete floors 4–6
handling_plan:
Prolonged frost period in January caused mandatory extended curing times per NS-EN 13670. Contractor NordBuild submitted a recovery plan on 29.01.2026 proposing extended shifts (6 days/week) and supplemental heating. Plan reviewed and approved by Bulk 03.02.2026. Net programme impact reduced from 3 weeks to 2 weeks. No impact on generator delivery or power-on milestone anticipated at this stage.

Update 03.02.2026: Recovery works underway — concrete pours on floor 4 resumed. Monitoring closely.

problem: Scope change request — UPS redundancy upgrade levels 3 and 4
handling_plan:
End customer (HyperScale Nordic AS) submitted a formal change request on 18.01.2026 to upgrade UPS redundancy from N to N+1 on IT hall levels 3 and 4. Preliminary cost assessment by NordBuild: NOK 55M including additional transformer bays and cable containment rerouting. Customer has requested a fixed-price proposal within 4 weeks. Schedule impact under assessment — could push White Space ready date by 3 weeks.

Update 03.02.2026: Cost proposal submitted to customer 01.02.2026. Awaiting acceptance.

problem: HV connection upgrade by Tensio delayed by permit backlog
handling_plan:
Tensio (grid operator) notified the project on 22.01.2026 that the permit for the 40 MW HV substation upgrade is delayed due to a backlog at NVE. Current estimate adds 8 weeks to the original connection schedule. Phase 1 commissioning at 20 MW is unaffected (existing grid capacity sufficient). Phase 2 full capacity is at risk.

Mitigation: exploring temporary diesel generation solution for bridging gap between Phase 1 and Phase 2. Meeting with Tensio senior management scheduled 20.02.2026.

Update 03.02.2026: Escalation letter sent to Tensio and NVE. Diesel bridging cost estimated at NOK 6–9M — within contingency.

problem: Financial stability of structural sub-contractor ByggeNord AS
handling_plan: ByggeNord AS (responsible for structural concrete works) has flagged cash-flow difficulties following delayed payment from another project. Risk that they reduce manning or stop works if cash position deteriorates further. Bulk treasury and legal consulted. Daily monitoring of ByggeNord progress reports initiated. NordBuild (main contractor) has been put on notice to activate contingency sub-contractor if needed.

problem: Waterproofing membrane NCR on level B2
handling_plan:
QC inspection 14.01.2026 identified non-compliant application of waterproofing membrane (Sika Deck 15) on 420 m² of B2 basement slab. NCR raised (TIT-NCR-0014). Sub-contractor submitted corrective action plan — full removal and reapplication of membrane. Rework completed 27.01.2026. Re-inspection passed 30.01.2026. NCR closed.

No programme impact.

problem: BIM coordination — 12 open MEP clashes pending resolution
handling_plan: Weekly clash detection run (Navisworks) identified 12 active clashes between HVAC ductwork and cable tray routing on levels 2 and 3. Sub-contractors (VVS-Gruppen AS and ElNord AS) have been given resolution deadline of 14.02.2026 to update models. No physical works affected yet as this scope is 6 weeks ahead of installation start on these levels.

problem: Facade cladding supplier (AluForm GmbH) declared force majeure following factory fire
handling_plan: Alternative supplier sourced in Gdansk, Poland (PolyFacade SA). Revised delivery schedule adds 6 weeks to facade works. Mitigation plan: resequencing internal MEP fit-out to absorb delay on critical path. Cost impact under assessment — preliminary estimate NOK 8-12M additional. Update 03.02.2026: Contract with PolyFacade SA signed. New delivery schedule confirmed. Impact on overall programme absorbed through resequencing. Cost delta finalised at NOK 9.4M — covered by contingency.

problem: Cooling system scope upgrade driving cost overrun
handling_plan: Decision taken in Q4 2025 to upgrade cooling redundancy from N to N+1 across all IT halls following updated customer SLA requirements. This has increased the cooling infrastructure budget by approximately NOK 40M. A value engineering exercise has been initiated targeting NOK 30M in savings across MEP scope. Update 03.02.2026: Value engineering workshop completed. Identified savings of NOK 22M. Remaining gap of NOK 18M to be covered by contingency. EAC revised to 1.54 BNOK.

problem: Key commissioning engineer (external) resigned with 3 weeks notice
handling_plan: Lead commissioning engineer (Torsten Brandt, Technode GmbH) has resigned effective January 2026. His role covers integrated Level 3 testing of all critical systems. Interim support has been engaged from OPS team. Recruitment underway — two candidates shortlisted. Risk: delay to commissioning programme if replacement not in place by Q2 2026. Update 03.02.2026: Candidate selected, offer accepted. Start date 01.03.2026. Knowledge transfer plan in place.

problem: Municipality raised concerns regarding stormwater management plan
handling_plan: Letter received from local municipality (Asker Kommune) on 14.01.2026 flagging that the stormwater attenuation solution does not align with updated local drainage standards. Technical response prepared by civil engineer (Rambøll) and submitted 28.01.2026. Awaiting approval. Risk: if rejected, redesign required — could impact landscaping and outdoor works schedule by 4–6 weeks.

problem: HV connection agreement with grid operator (Elvia) delayed
handling_plan: Elvia has indicated that the HV connection upgrade required to serve the facility at full 20 MW capacity will take 4 months longer than initially planned due to competing grid reinforcement works in the area. The project can commission at 10 MW (Phase 1) using existing grid capacity. Phase 2 capacity is at risk. Update 03.02.2026: Escalation to Elvia management initiated. Meeting scheduled for 19.02.2026. Exploring temporary diesel generation as bridging solution for Phase 2.

problem: Cable tray installation tolerances on level 2 not meeting spec
handling_plan: QC inspection on 27.01.2026 identified 34 cable tray hangers on level 2 that do not meet the ±5mm tolerance required by the specification. Sub-contractor (ElTech AS) has acknowledged the NCR and submitted a corrective action plan. Rework to be completed before MEP sign-off on level 2.
